reviewContext.userProblem: Workflow history is split. Self-improve and mutable-registry changes only write filesystem bundle snapshots (WorkflowHistoryStore). Service runs use the SQLite definition store, so there is no single lineage. LoopRegressionVerdict is defined but never used, so nothing proposes a rollback, and the web console has no history or rollback screen.
requiredOutcomes: Self-improve apply, registry create/update/delete/restore and `workflow restore` create definition-store versions (reverse delta, parent_version_id, definition_change_audit with actor/reason/evidence/diff_json) visible in `workflow definition history` and GraphQL workflowDefinitionHistory; restore/undo works from CLI and GraphQL.

Bundle snapshots are demoted to a file-restore auxiliary referenced from definition audit (bundleSnapshotBefore/After). (B) applies to them: parentSnapshotId, GraphQL workflowVersions/workflowVersionDiff/restoreWorkflowVersion (dry-run by default), and a unified text content diff.

Regression-driven rollback: loop.regressionRollback.policy manual|approval-required|automatic; proposals in runtime DB generation 13; approve/reject/check from CLI and GraphQL; automatic mode restores the prior version with an audit row.

Web console Versions tab: version list (actor/reason/time), structured diff between any two versions and against current, restore with confirmation, pending proposals with approve/reject; web lint/typecheck/test/build pass.
SurfaceCatalog rows with CLI+GraphQL parity, regenerated SDL, focused swift test suites green.
nonGoals: No change to the #179 definition document format or digest (scripts, mocks, add-on files stay out of the store).
No RielaMemory memory schema bump; no Package.swift/Package.resolved/VERSION change.
One-time CLI runs (`workflow run`, temporary workflows, `loop start`) never open definition tables.
No tombstone version for registry delete; service resolution after delete is unchanged.
constraints: Do not modify unrelated files or other worktrees.
No back-compat shims beyond the additive SQLite generation 12->13 migration.
Runtime records stay owned by the runtime store, never by workers or adapters.
Run swift build/test/swiftlint via arch -arm64 /bin/zsh -lc; .build writes are authorized.
Scratch and logs only under tmp/workflow-history-unification/.
Rollback/restore stays dry-run or approval-gated by default; automatic only when the rollback target's stored document opts in.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Design §2: the definition store is the single lineage. Bundle snapshots cannot be unified because the definition document excludes non-authored files, so they remain the file-restore auxiliary under fallback (B).
QA Q1: file-derived writes replace store-only head changes, record overwritten_changes_json, return warnings, and keep the replaced version restorable.
QA Q2: the policy comes from the rollback target's document, so an improvement cannot raise its own policy. Absent means manual.
QA Q3: registry delete writes an audit-only registryDelete row linking the before-delete snapshot.
QA Q4: the explicit `workflow definition rollback check` always works; the post-run hook evaluates only store-pinned service runs that declare loop.regressionRollback.
QA Q5: manual stores an informational `recorded` proposal; approval-required stores a `pending` proposal.
QA Q6: a durable `applying` claim blocks store-only writers with retryable definition_rollback_in_progress; crash recovery runs in approve/check, registry and coordinator recovery, and import.

QA Q7 (binding): bounded storage. No rows from one-time runs, no version when the digest is unchanged, collapsed no-op audits, and terminal proposals pruned by definition retention and gc. Only pending/applying are protected.
intentionalTradeoffs: Plans run as 6 serialized waves on a shared SwiftPM tree. A per-plan package-wide swift build can hit a sibling's in-progress compile errors; execution-protocol rule 4 logs these as outOfScope and reruns (WHU-R5-05 residual).
Three files are reused across waves, ordered by dependency: WorkflowSnapshotService.swift (02->07), WorkflowDefinitionCommand.swift (07->10), WorkflowDefinitionGraphQLProvider.swift (09->10).
WorkflowRegistryMutationResult needs a custom encode so JSON stays byte-identical when warnings is empty (WHU-R6-01 residual; a whu-06 test guards it).
Design §8/§9 text says '--workflow-json', but the real CLI form is a positional target; whu-08 tests the real forms (WHU-R6-02 residual, doc wording only).
supportedEdgeCases: A repeated identical no-op sync collapses and replay is idempotent (whu-05).
A crash between the file change and the definition write is recovered through durable sync intents (whu-07) and rollback claim recovery (whu-08).
Overwrite warnings are surfaced on registry, self-improve, restore and GraphQL restore results.
The rollback restore uses a CAS on the expected head; a dry-run restore is the default.
Proposal pruning is honored by gc dry-run (proposalsDropped).
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Automatic post-run regression evaluation for one-time file-origin runs (explicit/scheduled check only).
Blocking service runs after registry delete.
Byte-exact restore of non-authored assets through the definition store.

waveGates: After every wave, serial reconcile runs in the foreground with logs under tmp/workflow-history-unification/wave-<n>/: arch -arm64 /bin/zsh -lc 'swift build' exits 0 and the union of the wave members' focused filters exits 0 (SurfaceParity* excluded until W6). W1 additionally runs (cd web && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test src && bun run build) with exit 0.

Parallel members of a wave have disjoint writePaths: W1 01 RielaCore definition-store/loop files + RielaRetentionService, 02 history models/WorkflowHistoryStore/snapshot service/version commands, 03 RielaGraphQL, 04 web; W3 06 registry + GraphQL hosts + web REST registry handlers, 07 coordinator/self-improve/snapshot service/definition command; W4 08 rollback service + run hook, 09 definition GraphQL provider. A compile error inside a sibling's writePath is logged as outOfScope and rerun after the sibling is green; it is never fixed by the non-owner.

Cross-wave reuse of a file is intentional and serialized by dependencies: WorkflowSnapshotService.swift (02 W1 -> 07 W3), WorkflowDefinitionCommand.swift (07 W3 -> 10 W5), WorkflowDefinitionGraphQLProvider.swift (09 W4 -> 10 W5).
W6 final gates are listed in impl-plans/active/workflow-history-unification-11-catalog-sdl-docs.md.

acceptanceCriteria: SurfaceCatalog rows and help text exist for every new operation with CLI+GraphQL parity.
SDL generation is stable across two runs (equal hashes).
All final gates exit 0: build, focused filter, web gates, swiftlint, git diff --check, and an empty Package/VERSION/RielaMemory diff.
Docs describe the behavior change, recovery, rollback and bounded storage; the design §9 to test mapping is recorded.
